description: Reads a run's game_tags rows, optionally filtered by a minimum vote count.
signature: def read_tags(conn: sqlite3.Connection, run_id: str, *, min_votes: int = 0) -> pd.DataFrame
docstring:
Read tags for a run.

Args:
    conn: An open connection.
    run_id: The run to read.
    min_votes: Only tags with votes >= min_votes are returned. A row with votes=NULL is excluded whenever min_votes > 0 (NULL is treated as 'unknown vote count', not as zero), and included whenever min_votes == 0.

Returns:
    A DataFrame with columns appid, tag, votes, rank.
postconditions: Every returned row has votes >= min_votes, or min_votes == 0 and votes is NULL
Returns an empty DataFrame, not an error, for a run with no tags

edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns every tag row for the run regardless of votes, including NULL-vote rows

edge_cases.input: min_votes=10 with some rows having votes=NULL
edge_cases.expected_behavior: NULL-vote rows are excluded (NULL >= 10 is not true in SQL's three-valued logic, and this function makes that exclusion explicit rather than relying on SQL NULL semantics implicitly)
empty DataFrame with columns appid, tag, votes, rank

unit_tests.name: test_min_votes_filters_correctly
unit_tests.description: A fixture with tags at votes=5,15,25 and min_votes=10 returns only the 15 and 25 rows.

unit_tests.name: test_default_returns_all_including_null_votes
unit_tests.description: min_votes=0 includes a row with votes=NULL.

unit_tests.name: test_empty_result_for_untagged_run
unit_tests.description: A run with zero game_tags rows returns an empty DataFrame.
unit_tests.expected: empty DataFrame with columns appid, tag, votes, rank
